query:
UPDATE bulk_jobs b
         SET status = 'failed', error = 'lost by the job queue', updated_at = now()
         WHERE b.status IN ('queued', 'running')
           AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM axa_queue q
               WHERE q.name IN ($1, $2) AND q.args->>'job_id' = b.id::text AND q.status <> 'failed'
           )
           AND (
               EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM axa_queue q
                   WHERE q.name IN ($1, $2) AND q.args->>'job_id' = b.id::text AND q.status = 'failed'
               )
               OR b.updated_at < $3
           )
         RETURNING b.id
